title: Curves
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme; def-weil-scheme-over-base], with structure morphism $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. A *variety over $k$* is such an $X$ that is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] and for which $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] (Stacks Project, Definition Tag 020D). A *curve over $k$* is a variety over $k$ with dimension exactly $1$ [def-pc-dimension] (Stacks Project, Definition Tag 0A23). This differs from the curve convention of [def-sc-curves], which allows nonintegral schemes of dimension at most one over an algebraically closed field.
